name: llama.cpp+ZenDNN on EPYC 9755 128c: phi-4 None prefill tok/s (512in/128seq)
unit: tok/s prefill (llama-batched-bench pp512, 128 parallel seq, aggregate)
methodology: VENDOR MEASURED (AMD developer blog, ZD-066/067, Aug 18 2026). AMD EPYC 9755 128-core single socket (one NUMA node pinned, SMT off, 4.06GHz boost, DDR5-6400 12-ch); llama.cpp build b9326, ZenDNN 5.2.2 backend (-DGGML_ZENDNN=ON), ZENDNNL_MATMUL_ALGO=AOCL-DLP, llama-batched-bench 512in/128out/128 parallel seq, flash-attn on, KV cache = model precision, 3-run mean. phi-4 (BF16): ZenDNN 751.24 vs native-CPU 403.06 tok/s prefill. AGGREGATE over 128 seq, not per-request.
notes: Native-CPU baseline 403.06 tok/s -> ZenDNN 751.24 tok/s (1.86x). Vendor-published, single-socket pinned. Decode falls back to CPU path on ZenDNN 5.2.2 (small-batch not yet accelerated).
